reference_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025
  SELECT order_month AS month, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY order_month
)
SELECT month, revenue_eur,
  revenue_eur - LAG(revenue_eur) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change_eur
FROM monthly

  FROM sales

  GROUP BY order_month
)
SELECT m.month, m.revenue_eur, m.revenue_eur - p.revenue_eur AS change_eur
FROM monthly m
LEFT JOIN monthly p ON p.month = m.month - INTERVAL 1 MONTH
